what: AR43, Equipment's three screens, Reinforce, Jewels and War Emblems, each its own screen opened from Home's Equipment row: the frame's rows, the sockets' and Reinforce's images and every placement, from tools/blender/equipment_pages.py (cut); drawn in code, no image input

order: Put in, Replace (84) or Take out (92)

rowHolds.count: the item's sockets by its rarity: Common 1, Uncommon 2, Rare 3, Epic and above 4

sockets.note: n sockets centred: the first's left at the middle - (n - 1) x 30 - 23
sockets.picture: the emblem at 44, centred (1 point in)

stat.note: the stat's name, a word a line (Critical / Damage)

empty.mark: SocketEmptyEmblem, its 28 box centred in the socket

sort.tap: 44 points high over the pill, centred on it

bag.note: a scrolling row of the bag's item cells (the kit's, its emblems), cut 8 inside the panel's edge; sorted by rarity, highest first; the chosen one SocketGlow under it and SocketEdgeLit over it, both on a box 1.5 outside the cell

said.note: two lines left of the press: the set and rarity in the rarity's colour, bold; then the stat in the text colour

order: Put in, Replace (84) or Take out (92)

level.at: right of the word, 3 points on
level.colour: the light #F0E2C4; the chosen row's #7CF0A4 once risen, #FF786E once failed

ring.stack: ReinforceRingGlow, ReinforceRing, ReinforceRingOuter, then the gear's cell

gear.note: the kit's item cell in the item's rarity, the gear's picture at 0.94

level.colour: the light; #7CF0A4 once risen, #FF786E once failed

stone.note: the kit's Common item cell, the stone's picture (AR31's StoneLow, StoneMid, StoneHigh) at 0.94, a hairline in the edge #E2CFA4 over its rim

odds.note: before every press, the two adding to 100

cost.pill: the channel #0E1D23, a hairline in the edge, cut 4 at every corner

press.kind: lit (one) when it can go; off, the well's plate with faint words, when the stones are short

layout.rowImages: every screen's list rows: at rest RowPlate and RowEdge; the chosen row RowGlass, RowGlassWash, RowEdge (in the facet), RowGlassLight and RowPoint, gliding as one

short: You have <have> <stone> stones: <need - have> short (hurt, bold)

states.ready: the press lit; the levels in the light
states.short: the press off; the stones' count in the hurt
states.rose: the chosen row's level, the level by the ring, the ring and its glow in the good
states.failed: the same in the hurt; the level stays

seeds.note: upgrade_motion.SEEDS: Answer is the stand-in server's, the game uses the real answer

motion.kit: Config.Hud.Motion.Press (the press), Count (the Credits and the stat), Burst (the sparks), Shine (the gear's one shine) and Config.Hud.Pop at Rungs.Level (the level), as the game has them
rowTapped: the row squeezes and springs back past its size (Press), about its middle; nothing waits on the server
the glass (RowGlass, RowGlassWash, RowGlassLight, RowPoint) glides to it over Glide 0.2 s, out3, no overshoot: a marker
the old work fades over Leave 0.1 s (smooth) sliding Slide 8 points left; the new one fades in over Cross 0.16 s (out3) from 8 points right, from the touch
reinforce: the press squeezes (Press); from Press.Least its light holds at Pending 0.6 until the answer, then returns over 0.1 s

the stones: 3 of the cost's stone, each k leaving at k x Apart 0.035 s and flying Fly 0.22 s: e = u^2 (eased in) along a quadratic curve from the pill's stone, through (the pill's x, the ring's y), into the ring's middle; its size 1 - 0.4 e; it fades over its last quarter

the breath, from 0.06 s to the answer + 0.03: u = (t - 0.06) / (Answer - 0.06); a circle (UICorner 0.5, UIStroke 1.6 in the light) of radius 27 + Inhale x (1 - in3(u)), the stroke's transparency 1 - (0.25 + 0.6u); ReinforceWaveGlow scaled to it in the light at transparency 1 - 0.35u; inside, a circle of radius 25 in the glint at transparency 1 - 0.14u
the gear's cell grows to 1 + Lift x in3(u), Lift 0.05
answer: either way the cost leaves: the Credits count down (Count, expo over Count.Seconds)
the ring (ReinforceRing, ReinforceRingGlow) and the levels, by the ring and in the row, turn over 0.08 s (out3): the old fading as the new one shows
success: the flash: ReinforceFlash, transparency 1 - f, f = (1 - age / Flash)^2, Flash 0.14

the wave, for WaveFor 0.32 s, v = age / WaveFor: a circle of radius 27 + Wave x out3(v), Wave 26, its UIStroke 0.4 + 2.2 (1 - v) wide, white turning #7CF0A4 by min(2.5v, 1), transparency 1 - (1 - v)^1.5; ReinforceWaveGlow scaled with it in the green at transparency 1 - 0.5 (1 - v)
the sparks: Burst from the ring's edge (radius 23), in #7CF0A4
the gear: size 1 + Lift x (1 - out3(age / Pop.Seconds)) + Kick x the pop's swell, Kick 0.1; Shine across its picture
the level pops at its rung (Pop) in #7CF0A4, by the ring and in the row; the stat counts to its after (Count)
the next rank's lines fade in Texts 0.3 s after the yes, over Cross; the glow is gone by Settle 0.8 s
fail: no flash: a circle of radius 26 in #FFD2CC at transparency 1 - 0.3 f
the crack: ReinforceCrack drawn in left to right over Crack 0.06 s (a clip widening), then faded over CrackFade 0.4 s
the gear dims to Dim 0.55 over 0.08 s and back by 0.45 s; its size 1 + Lift - (Lift + Sink) x out3(age / 0.1) + Sink x smooth((age - 0.15) / 0.25), Sink 0.04
the work shakes: x + Shake x sin(age / ShakeFor x 6 pi) x (1 - age / ShakeFor), Shake 2, ShakeFor 0.24: the ring, the gear, the levels, the stat, the lines and the press
the level stays, in #FF786E; the lines fade in at Texts / 2

reinforce.rules: the odds before every press, adding to 100; nothing protects a fail; the odds and price keep docs/roblox-rules.md's paid random items' rules (Reinforce's piece)

layoutNote: measured on the smallest phone (568 by 320); the screen takes the phone's whole width as Reinforce's does

presses.rule: a press is drawn live only when it can act (research's must-fix, 14:27); with nothing to do it is off, the well's plate with faint words. The lit one is Put in, Replace or Take out; Combine is quiet when live, never lit

jewels.Put in: a bag jewel chosen and the socket empty
jewels.Replace: a bag jewel chosen and the socket holding one, which goes back to the bag
jewels.Take out: the socket chosen alone, holding one
jewels.Combine: three or more of the chosen level, under level 5; free and sure, its price the three jewels (research, 14:27)

emblems.Put in: a bag emblem chosen and the socket empty
emblems.Replace: a bag emblem chosen and the socket holding one
emblems.Take out: the socket chosen alone, holding one

presses.free: putting in and taking out are free; no price is drawn

numbers: jewel points by level and emblem stats are stand-ins until TR47 (research)

SocketFill.use: a socket's dark well, in its own colours, never tinted; the bottom of every socket and of the Jewels screen's bag cells. Sliced at Cut 8 on every side: one image serves the 40, 44 and 46 point sockets, its corner cut 6.2 at every size

SocketLight.tint: the socket's colour (a jewel's ring, an emblem's rarity), ImageTransparency 0; its strength is in the picture
SocketLight.use: the colour's light rising in a held or coloured socket, over the fill: stretched to the socket (ScaleType Stretch), never sliced. Not on an empty emblem socket or a bag cell

SocketEdge.tint: the socket's colour at ImageTransparency 0.15; a jewel bag cell's and an empty emblem socket's the screen's edge #E2CFA4 at 0.5
SocketEdge.use: a socket's rim, at rest, 1.4 points on the outline, over the light. Its box is the socket's with Pad on every side. Sliced at Cut 10

SocketEdgeLit.use: a socket's rim, the chosen socket's or bag cell's, in place of the rest rim, 2.2 points on the outline, over the light. Its box is the socket's with Pad on every side. Sliced at Cut 10

SocketGlow.use: the chosen socket's or bag cell's glow, under its fill. Its box is the socket's with Pad on every side. Sliced at Cut 26

SocketEmptyJewel.tint: the socket's jewel colour at ImageTransparency 0.45
SocketEmptyJewel.use: an empty jewel socket's mark, a diamond, its 16 point box centred in the socket

SocketEmptyEmblem.use: an empty emblem socket's mark, a star, its 28 point box centred in the socket

RowEmptyJewel.use: a list row's empty jewel, a ring, its 12 point box centred where the row's jewel would stand

RowEmptyEmblem.use: a list row's empty emblem socket, a star, its 16 point box centred where the row's emblem would stand

RowPlate.use: a list row at rest: the well's plate, in its own colours, never tinted; its top left cut 6. Sliced at Cut, its ends only: drawn at its own height (46), it stretches along to the row, 286 points on the smallest phone

RowGlass.use: the chosen row: the dark glass, in its own colours, never tinted; its top left cut 6. Sliced at Cut, its ends only: drawn at its own height (46), it stretches along to the row, 286 points on the smallest phone

RowEdge.tint: at rest the edge #E2CFA4, ImageTransparency 0; on the chosen row the facet #8FC4C8 at 0.2
RowEdge.use: a row's hairline over its plate or glass; its box the row's with Pad on every side, sliced as the row

RowGlassWash.use: the chosen row's light, rising toward its lit right edge, over the glass and under the hairline: stretched to the row (ScaleType Stretch), never sliced

RowGlassLight.use: the chosen row's lit right edge and its glow: its box's middle on the row's right edge, its top 10 above the row's

RowPoint.use: the chosen row's point toward the work: its box's left on the row's right edge, its top 14 below the row's

ReinforceRing.tint: at rest the light #F0E2C4; risen #7CF0A4, failed #FF786E; ImageTransparency 0.1
ReinforceRing.use: the ring round the gear: its box's middle on the ring's, 27 points round, 1.6 wide

ReinforceRingOuter.use: the ring's outer line, 4 points out: its box's middle on the ring's, 31 points round, 1 wide

ReinforceRingGlow.tint: at rest the glint #FFF6E2; risen #7CF0A4, failed #FF786E; ImageTransparency 0.82
ReinforceRingGlow.use: the light in the ring, under the gear's cell: its box's middle on the ring's

ReinforceFlash.tint: white; ImageTransparency 1 - f, f = (1 - age / Flash)^2 from the yes
ReinforceFlash.use: a success's flash, the ring filled with light and its glow, over the gear: its box's middle on the ring's

ReinforceWaveGlow.tint: the breath's light, the wave's green: see reinforce.motion
ReinforceWaveGlow.use: the soft glow of a ring of light at 27 points: scaled with the breath and the wave, its box's middle on the ring's

ReinforceCrack.use: a fail's crack across the ring, in its own colours (#FF786E with a pale core), never tinted: its box's middle on the ring's; drawn in left to right, then faded (reinforce.motion)
